title: The Prince
summary: A Renaissance handbook on how rulers gain and keep power: be realistic about how people act rather than how they should act, it is safer to be feared than loved if you can't be both, appear virtuous but act as needed, rely on yourself not on luck or allies, and prepare in calm times for the storm.
